function_signature: def template_attack_match(test_trace: np.ndarray, templates: Dict[int, Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]]) -> np.ndarray
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.7 (13 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: The templates input is a dict[intermediate value 0-255 -> (mean of shape (D,), cov of shape (D,D))]
pooled covariance or Tikhonov regularization must be used to avoid a singular matrix
numerical stability: use log-det + Cholesky rather than a direct inv
author: Zhou Wenquan
